info.title: Hagency owner Agent API
info.description: Current implemented HTTP contract (protocol v3; route prefix remains v1). Native clients only: exactly one matching public Host; no Origin, Cookie or duplicate Authorization. X-Forwarded-Host is ignored and cannot replace the actual Host check. User-session and device bearers are different capabilities. All /hagency/api/v1 responses use Cache-Control: no-store; JSON requests ≤131072 bytes. Model/provider secrets never belong here; non-secret local configuration may transit only the execution-configuration-v1 device queue. Global permanent-owner Agent identity is independent of Project/Room; one designated stable owner device executes each Agent. Project=adopted Matrix Space; Room membership stays independent. No Fleet/Engagement compatibility, import or Agent transfer. Errors use {code}; unsupported operations are 400, not an assumed 404. This spec excludes Palpo/Pasion/Matrix APIs, browser same-origin proxy and owner-local console APIs. Newly allocated Hagency entity IDs use a type prefix plus a 26-character lowercase ULID. IDs remain opaque to clients; authorization tokens are separate 256-bit random values. Matrix room/event IDs and immutable transaction identities are not generated by this scheme. Includes the identity-only /hagency/agent-crypto prefix and its separate owner-scoped /receive namespace; these SDK responses use Matrix errcode/error, require deviceBearer and cannot grant encrypted task execution.
